python3 << 'EOF'
# Bbox y-coordinates (top of each yellow bar)
# All bars end at y=867 (bottom)
y_tops = [127, 597, 507, 588, 688, 751, 769, 787, 796, 804]
y_bottom = 867

# Calculate heights in pixels
heights = [y_bottom - y for y in y_tops]
print("Heights (pixels):", heights)

# Determine scale factor
# Assuming US bar (first bar) is at 820 million
us_height = heights[0]
us_value = 820.0
scale = us_height / us_value  # pixels per million
print(f"Scale: {scale} pixels per million")

# Calculate values for all bars
values = [h / scale for h in heights]
print("Values (millions):", values)

# Total 2021 funding
total = sum(values)
print(f"Total 2021 funding: {total} million")

# US - China
us = values[0]
china = values[3]  # 4th bar (index 3)
difference = us - china
print(f"US - China: {us} - {china} = {difference} million")

# Fraction
fraction = difference / total
print(f"Fraction: {difference} / {total} = {fraction}")
print(f"Fraction (rounded): {round(fraction, 4)}")
EOF

python3 << 'EOF'
# Using round number estimates based on visual inspection and bbox analysis
# 2021 funding values (yellow bars) in millions USD
values_2021 = {
    'United States': 820,
    'United Kingdom': 300,
    'Russia': 400,
    'China': 310,
    'Germany': 200,
    'France': 130,
    'Israel': 110,
    'India': 90,
    'Japan': 80,
    'Australia': 70
}

# Total 2021 funding
total_2021 = sum(values_2021.values())
print(f"Total 2021 funding: {total_2021} million USD")

# US contribution
us_2021 = values_2021['United States']
print(f"US 2021: {us_2021} million USD")

# China contribution
china_2021 = values_2021['China']
print(f"China 2021: {china_2021} million USD")

# Difference
difference = us_2021 - china_2021
print(f"US - China: {difference} million USD")

# Fraction
fraction = difference / total_2021
print(f"Fraction: {difference} / {total_2021} = {fraction}")
print(f"Fraction (rounded to 4 decimals): {round(fraction, 4)}")
print(f"Fraction as percentage: {fraction * 100:.2f}%")

# Simplified fraction
import math
gcd = math.gcd(difference, total_2021)
print(f"Simplified fraction: {difference//gcd}/{total_2021//gcd}")
EOF
